info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Pharmacy Prescriptions Interactions-v1-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescription Interactions API facilitates the retrieval of interactions associated with pharmacy prescriptions. This endpoint allows users to access important information regarding potential drug interactions, enhancing patient safety and compliance. Typically used by healthcare providers, pharmacists, and integrated health systems, this API supports decision-making in medication management. By providing insights into prescription interactions, it enables proactive measures to avoid adverse reactions and optimize therapeutic outcomes.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch potential interactions between prescribed medications. It evaluates the current prescription list and identifies any adverse effects or contraindications based on established medical guidelines.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve interactions related to prescriptions. The client must provide the necessary information in JSON format as per the defined schema to fetch relevant interaction data.

200.description: Successfully retrieved interactions for the specified prescriptions.

ListPharmacyPrescriptionsInteractionsReq.description: Represents the request body for getting prescription interactions. This is a string that could contain pertinent information for the operation.
